# CodePulse

> CodePulse builds data tools for developers. Engineering analytics for GitHub teams, plus fast data APIs for AI developers.

## YouTube Transcript API
- [YouTube Transcript API (Apify Actor)](https://apify.com/codepulsehq/youtube-transcript-api): transcripts of any public YouTube video, playlist or channel as text, timestamps, RAG chunks, Markdown, SRT or VTT. No YouTube API key. Pay per transcript ($3.90 per 1,000), failed videos free.
- [Examples and guides on GitHub](https://github.com/CodePulseHQ/youtube-transcript-api): curl, Python, JavaScript and MCP examples, RAG chunking, fixing RequestBlocked/IpBlocked on cloud servers.
- [Guides](https://codepulsehq.github.io/youtube-transcript-api/): how to get YouTube transcripts without an API key, fix RequestBlocked/IpBlocked on cloud servers, build RAG over YouTube, MCP setup, bulk downloads, SRT/VTT, and a comparison of the options.
- [More tools by CodePulse](https://codepulsehq.github.io/): SEC EDGAR, US federal opportunities, domain intelligence, speech to text.
